selected_evidence.requirement: Convert Latin-1 filenames to UTF-8 while retaining contents and directory structure
selected_evidence.summary: Byte-level listings show Latin-1 source bytes e9 becoming UTF-8 c3a9. Matching SHA-256 hashes prove café.txt and résumé.txt retained their contents.
The original plain.txt, café.txt, and résumé.txt remain under imported/ after conversion and restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Report collisions without overwriting or dropping the source
selected_evidence.summary: The initially existing converted/plain.txt remains distinct from imported/plain.txt and conversion-report.txt records COLLISION_PRESERVED with missing=0.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and Linux 2.6.22-14-generic remained installed; only bundled Perl modules were used.

Evidence captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered SSH, mounted storage, filenames, hashes, UTF-8 validity, source tree, and collision report.
